surface_functionalization: DMA-TMS treatment to selectively inhibit growth on dielectrics by rendering the SiO2 surface –Si(CH3)3 terminated
evidence: All experiments were performed on 300 mm Si(100) wafers covered with 100 nm thermally grown SiO2. ... Ru ASD was performed by a DMA-TMS surface pretreatment step followed by Ru ALD. DMA-TMS was used to enable Ru ASD on TiN versus SiO2, as aminosilanes can selectively inhibit growth on dielectric surfaces.
